objective: Increase trustworthiness of the future native-4K Visual Fidelity evidence by proving the actual OnRenderImage transfer state for every hero/oblique/grazing still, rather than relying on buffer class plus only the last sRGB observation.

problemFound.summary: The pre-cull display-transfer guard checked each camera target's sRGB flag, and HDR runtime QA counted HDR sources/LDR destinations, but runtime telemetry only retained lastSourceSrgb/lastDestinationSrgb for the final still. Therefore the image-effect execution path did not independently prove scene-linear HDR input and sRGB LDR output for each of the three authoritative stills.
problemFound.risk: A transfer-state drift affecting one still could undermine exposure/color/material review while leaving the existing HDR/LDR format counters satisfied.

changes.message: qa: track per-still display transfer state
details: Added linearHdrSourceInvocationCount and srgbLdrDestinationInvocationCount runtime counters.
A source invocation contributes to the stricter counter only when it is HDR and source.sRGB is false.
A destination invocation contributes to the stricter counter only when it is LDR and destination.sRGB is true.
Counters are reset with the existing authoritative capture telemetry and exposed read-only to QA.

changes.message: qa: require linear HDR to sRGB LDR on every still
details: Authoritative capture now fails unless all 3/3 stills report linear HDR sources and sRGB LDR destinations.
Last-frame source/destination sRGB state remains an additional sanity check rather than the sole transfer observation.
Runtime receipt schema advanced to 1.2 and records both stricter counters plus everyStillHadLinearHdrSource/everyStillHadSrgbLdrDestination.
Added independent receipt-file validation so persisted runtime evidence can be checked without pretending it is a visual score.

changes.message: qa: codify per-still display transfer evidence
details: Machine-readable contract now requires per-still scene-linear HDR input and sRGB LDR output.
Receipt schema and failure policy explicitly reject any canonical still that misses the transfer state.

changes.message: qa: bind display transfer to per-still runtime counters
details: Display-transfer contract now documents the runtime telemetry bridge between the pre-cull target guard and the HDR-tonemap receipt.
No source-side pass awards visual points or clears visible defects.

expectedVisualScoreImpactIfRuntimeEviden.reason: The change does not improve scene pixels by itself; it prevents incorrectly transferred pixels from being accepted as trustworthy evidence for these categories.

nextBlocker: A Unity 6000.3.0f1-capable runner/editor session is still required. On first runtime availability, stop speculative expansion, compile, execute the native review packet, require 3/3 linear-HDR and 3/3 sRGB-LDR transfer observations, then inspect hero/oblique/grazing 3840x2160 frames plus 100% crops before assigning any Visual Fidelity score.
notes: No earthquake, disaster, or reconstruction content was introduced.
The runtime receipt is evidence plumbing only and cannot substitute for pixel review.
